title: The house was drawn once,
then shot six ways.

title: No model draws a Samako machine;
they hop in as photographs.
chapters.sub: Each machine is the photographer's original with its background removed, and it only moves across the frame, on twos, landing on the beat.

title: Every cut sits on a beat,
and the silence falls on her sip.
chapters.sub: At 144 bpm a beat is exactly 10 frames, and in film A the track's own one-beat silence lands on her sip of tea.
chapters.source: rebuilt from the breakdown and the eval log; the 6 Oct session ran on another machine

title: The models made the footage,
and code did everything else.
chapters.sub: The video models brought the house to life, and code added the type, the product, the stop-motion and the grain on all 360 frames.
chapters.source: rebuilt from the breakdown and the eval log; the 6 Oct session ran on another machine

items.s: Takes cut back to 12 or 8 poses a second.
A hop lands on the beat; its shadow grows as it lifts.
Letters landing one pose apart. No model writes a word.
Four cuts rendered in three minutes.

title: A model that never saw the brief
watched each film three times.
chapters.sub: Each time it said what the film was for and what it read, and only what all three runs agreed on got fixed.
